label: end-of-episode clock: GO/D2 steps in the last ~5-10 trials, mainly when choosing a2
explanation: Fires only late in the episode: 0 activations before ep_trial 80, 99.5% of steps in trials 90-99, and 100% of activation mass at value-head output < 5.22 (the low value at episode end, since little future reward remains). Within that span it fires on GO (54% of mass) and D2 (44%) and almost never on D1. It is biased toward a2 (88% of mass; policy logit strongly toward a2) and toward unrewarded previous trials (prev_reward=0 has 79% of mass; the biggest activations are at GO right after an unrewarded trial). It also responds to penalty/D1-fixation-error inputs (in_rew=-1 rate 0.5). Magnitude grows toward the end of the episode, with the largest values on the last trial. (ep_trial>=90)&(phase!=D1) reaches 96% recall but precision is only 0.16. Adding action==2 and ep_trial>=95 gives the best simple F1 (0.49). (value<4)&(phase!=D1)&(action==2) does about as well (F1 0.49, mass 0.85). Precision stays low because many late-episode a2 steps are silent. Uses action at GO, which is the upcoming choice of the agent itself and fine for it to compute; no future random outcome is used.
